newsitem.title: USA: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were called to open little changed on Monday, although some traders expected the market to follow-through on Friday's sell-off.

New York raws ended sharply lower on Friday, as speculators took profits on the market's recent rally. October sugar ended down 0.20 cent at 11.38 cents a pound, after sinking to a session low at 11.32 cents. March fell 0.13 cent, to 11.65 cents.
In London, white sugar futures were flat to firmer in thin trading early Monday. LIFFE October was up 40 cents as of 0851 EDT/1251 GMT, to $320.50.
